liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **prerecorded intro music**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **banter - ungodly beautiful**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **banter - luckiest people on earth**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **banter - the cold mountain air**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **banter - inviting out PHJB**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **banter - PHJB**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Carnival Time**: rare: 7 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **mmj2011-06-05.tlm170.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 31 songs; 149 min [1]
- **mmj2011-06-05.tlm170.flac16**: audience recording; 31 songs; 149 min [2]
- **mmj2011-06-05**: source not stated; 25 songs; 148 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: The audio quality is described as decent but slightly muted [5]
- **mmj2011-06-05.akg481.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 146 min [4]

## Around the show

- A PA power failure occurred between 8:31 and 8:39 in the song [1]
- A PA power failure occurred between 8:31 and 8:39 in the song [2]
- Preservation Hall Jazz Band performed as guests during the set [3]
- Equipment issues caused the first 1.5 minutes of the first track to be missing [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2011-06-05.tlm170.flac24**: taped by Scott Bernstein; transferred by Scott Bernstein; source: Audience [1]. Also: Scott Bernstein recorded, mastered, and tracked the 24-bit audio file [1]
- **mmj2011-06-05.tlm170.flac16**: taped by Scott Bernstein; transferred by Scott Bernstein; source: Audience [2]. Also: Scott Bernstein recorded, mastered, and tracked the 16-bit audio file [2]
- **mmj2011-06-05**: taped by Rob Clarke; transferred by Rob Clarke; source: Neumann KM184> V2> Sony PCM-M10 [3]
- **mmj2011-06-05.akg481.flac16**: taped by vanark; transferred by vanark; source: AKG C480B/CK61 > Edirol UA-5 (Oade Warm+ mod) > Edirol R-09HR (24/48) [4]
